evidence.observation: Reboiler reads 437-440 °C, physically implausible versus the ~70 °C column body, and creeps monotonically upward
Column profile flat and stable at 70 °C top-to-bottom with only ~7 °C drop to condenser, no developing separation profile
Reflux and distillate flows near zero (0.1-0.5 L/h) with FYI702 ratio noisy around 6.8-7.3

args.missing_evidence: An independent reboiler temperature/heater duty reading to confirm T701 sensor fault, plus a distillate composition sample to test whether any separation occurred
